title: Onboard prism-13b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Patel
description: Onboard prism-13b v1.0 into the model registry and wire it into automated changelog generation. Motivation: prism-13b is a community open model with competitive quality/cost tradeoffs that our customers requested; adding it to the registry lets the serving/runtime teams validate performance and gives product teams a curated profile for predictable latency/cost. This PR adds model metadata (architecture, tokenizer, recommended quantization), multiple performance profiles tuned for A100-80GB, T4, and CPU-only fallbacks, and updates the changelog automation to include a per-model entry so new onboards create release notes automatically. What changed: 1) new file models/prism/metadata.json with schema-aligned fields (author, license, architecture, hf_id, recommended_params, quantization_profiles); 2) perf_profiles/prism-13b-v1.0.yaml with measured throughput/latency/kv-cache behavior and recommended batch/sequence defaults for each hardware tier; 3) scripts/changelog-gen.py updated to pick up registry metadata and emit human-friendly notes; 4) added lightweight integration tests that validate metadata schema and perf profile parsing; 5) small README and example snippet in examples/prism-quickstart.md. Validation: ran nightly perf canary on A100 and T4, results included in validation_results field; all CI checks passed after addressing a linting nit and a flaky perf test. Checklist: - [x] metadata file conforms to registry schema - [x] perf profiles validated on A100/T4 - [x] changelog automation updated and unit-tested - [x] docs/quickstart example added - [x] tests added for schema parsing Rollout plan: merged to main, will be picked up by the next registry release automation; monitoring alert created to watch serving latency regressions for prism-13b for first 48h after rollout. See linked Linear tickets ENG-2345 and PM-112 for follow-ups (model rollout tracking and sample prompts for quality monitoring).

validation_results: A100-80GB: 32 tokens/s median throughput (seq_len=1024, batch=4), p50 latency 85ms, p95 140ms; matches target within 5%
T4: 8 tokens/s median throughput (seq_len=512, batch=2), p50 latency 280ms; CPU fallback profiling indicates 0.5 tokens/s for small-batch inference
release_notes: Onboarded prism-13b v1.0: added model metadata and performance profiles for A100/T4/CPU; changelog automation updated to include per-model entries; added quickstart example and integration tests; recommended quantization profiles (q4f, q8) included; see ENG-2345 for rollout tracking.
